capabilities: Switch idle Markdown notes into Reading view after a configurable timeout
Run the timer while Obsidian is active or minimized
Open previously viewed documents in Reading view at startup
intentEvidence: automatically switches Markdown pages in Live Preview or Source mode into Reading view
motivation: The README opens with 'Annoyed of files still being in editing mode after leaving or closing Obsidian?', indicating the author built it to remove that irritation.
problem: Obsidian leaves previously opened files in Live Preview or Source editing mode, which annoys users who want past notes to open in Reading view.
summary: Timer-based plugin that automatically switches Markdown notes into Reading view after a set period of inactivity or on startup.
